```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)
```

```{r}
dat_blocked <- agridat::omer.sorghum |> filter(env == "E3") |> dplyr::select(-env)

str(dat_blocked)
```


```{r}
m_fixed <- lm(yield ~ gen + rep , data = dat_blocked)

DHARMa::simulateResiduals(m_fixed, plot=T)
```

```{r}
emmeans(m_fixed, ~gen, 
        contr = list(c(1, rep(0, 16), -1)))
```


```{r}
m_mixed <- lmer(yield ~ gen +(1|rep), data = dat_blocked)
head(dat_blocked)
# DHARMa::simulateResiduals(m_mixed, plot = T)


summary(m_mixed)
getME(m_mixed, "X")[1:10,]
getME(m_mixed, "Z")[1:10,]
getME(m_mixed, "b")

emmeans(m_mixed, ~gen, 
        contr = list(c(1, rep(0, 16), -1)))

```
